topic: Neon signs, light towers, path lights and torches
summary: Custom LED neon signs run on 12 volts with a dimmer and are usually 24 to 36 in wide (0.6 to 0.9 m) for events and trade shows, about 0.4 m tall for a short phrase; wall, hanging or freestanding mounts. Outdoor events need lighting for safety: United Rentals lists portable light towers (10 to 32 ft masts, parking lots and entrances), balloon lights (10 to 13 ft mast, about 60 to 145 sq ft coverage; tents, walkways, registration tables) and light stands (4 to 12 ft). Planners must budget power or a generator and keep towers away from guests' walking lines. A battery 8 ft aluminum telescoping tower (Larson Electronics) weighs 23 lb and runs on a 200 Wh lithium battery. Path lights come in sets: a 6-light set with 36 in spacing lights 15 ft (4.6 m), stakes adjust from 9 to 14.5 in tall, up to 3 sets chain on one adapter. Tiki torches stand 60 in (1.52 m) with a wick head about 3 in across, burn about 5 hours per 12 oz fill; check venue fire rules and keep them clear of tents.
